name: Notify Release

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        description: 'Published release tag'
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag_name:
        description: 'Published release tag (empty = nearest tag on selected ref)'
        required: false
        type: string

jobs:
  notify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Cloning repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      
      - name: Get Latest Tag
        id: get_tag
        env:
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.tag_name }}
        run: |
          LATEST_TAG="$RELEASE_TAG"
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            LATEST_TAG=$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0 2>/dev/null || echo "")
          fi
          git check-ref-format "refs/tags/$LATEST_TAG"
          
          if [ -z "$LATEST_TAG" ]; then
            echo "No tags found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "LATEST_TAG=$LATEST_TAG" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Latest tag: $LATEST_TAG"
          
      - name: Get Release Information
        id: get_release
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          RELEASE_DATA=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$LATEST_TAG")
          
          echo "$RELEASE_DATA" | jq -r '.body' > release_notes.txt
          
          echo "FORMATTED_NOTES<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          cat release_notes.txt >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          
          echo "Release notes fetched successfully"

      - name: Get All Release Assets
        id: get_assets
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/releases/tags/$LATEST_TAG" -o release.json
          
          bytes_to_hr() {
            awk -v size="$1" 'BEGIN{
              split("B KB MB GB", unit);
              for (i=1; size>=1024 && i<4; i++) size/=1024;
              printf "%.2f %s", size, unit[i]
            }'
          }
          
          echo "Processing assets..."
          
          # Initialize all asset variables
          APK_UNIVERSAL=""
          APK_ARM64=""
          APK_ARM32=""
          APK_X86=""
          WINDOWS_SETUP=""
          WINDOWS_PORTABLE=""
          LINUX_DEB=""
          LINUX_RPM=""
          LINUX_FLATPAK=""
          LINUX_PORTABLE=""
          
          # Parse each asset
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            ASSET_URL=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.browser_download_url')
            ASSET_SIZE=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.size')
            FILE_NAME=$(echo "$line" | jq -r '.name')
            SIZE_HR=$(bytes_to_hr "$ASSET_SIZE")
            
            echo "Found asset: $FILE_NAME"
            
            # Categorize assets
            case "$FILE_NAME" in
              *app-release.apk* | *universal*.apk)
                APK_UNIVERSAL="[Universal APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *arm64-v8a*.apk)
                APK_ARM64="[ARM64 APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;
              *armeabi-v7a*.apk)
                APK_ARM32="[ARM32 APK]($ASSET_URL) \`$SIZE_HR\`"
                ;;

results.content:
Skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs

Pattern: P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW (workflow_skip)

When is skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs applicable?

Assess skip explicitly dispensable workflow runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

Contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute

Method: Treat as behavior-changing rather than a safe default; Require evidence about affected checks

Reported finding: Explicit skipping has limited aggregate impact.

Reported metrics: {"comparison": "less_than", "paid_vm_time_reduction_upper_bound_percent": 0.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.4; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
trigger CI for each submitted revision


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
omit a revision only under an approved skip policy


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-SKIP-WORKFLOW/after.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-trigger CI for each submitted revision
+omit a revision only under an approved skip policy
contraindications: Strict contract requires all triggers to execute
preconditions: Repository policy permits a specific run to be omitted

results.content:
Suppress schedules during repository inactivity

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

When is suppress schedules during repository inactivity applicable?

Assess suppress schedules during repository inactivity for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Periodic results depend only on repository changes

Contraindications: External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks

Method: Identify meaningful activity rather than generated self-updates; Resume when relevant inputs change

Reported finding: Inactivity suppression saves some scheduled work.

Reported metrics: {"paid_scheduled_vm_time_reduction_percent": 1.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.2; Table 5; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
run on every schedule tick


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
run on a tick only if relevant activity occurred


Literature example diff:

--- knowledge/examples/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE/before.txt
+++ knowledge/examples/P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE/after.txt
@@ -1,2 +1,2 @@
 # ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
-run on every schedule tick
+run on a tick only if relevant activity occurred
contraindications: External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks
preconditions: Periodic results depend only on repository changes
